content.short: BrightID is a social identity network.
content.description: BrightID seeks to reform identity verification by delivering an open-source, non-invasive, decentralized technology that lets individuals prove to apps that they are not using multiple accounts. This approach centers on a proof of unique identity that is established through the creation and analysis of a social graph, a structured map of connections among users. By relying on this social-graph method, BrightID provides a verifiable signal of singular identity within a decentralized framework.
